basic_info.description: 2 bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income (AMI).  Maximum income for 2 people = $119,900; 3 = $134,850; 4 = $149,850, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer &  income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) &  subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing  Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, May 13th, 2024. Visit  https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer  education verification due on June 3rd, 2024 at 5:00 PM. Saturday May 18th 1-4pm, Sunday May  19th 1-4pm, Thursday May 23rd 5-7pm. FAIR HOUSING OPPORTUNITY.
